teaches: affirmative clause with the set stated is the one-outcome cell
with the set omitted the excluded item is the only filler of a clause role, so that role assigns the case
the tradition also treats verb-like exclusion words; they are outside the taught closed table, so no cell may be borrowed for them
licensed but analysis-dependent: negation opens a second admissible case and the pack must not collapse it to one
polarity is a required input; an unstated polarity is an abstention, never a default to the accusative
transfer: the genitive on an annexed complement holds irrespective of the surrounding construction, so this row is decided without consulting polarity at all
